headline: New rules for
*menopause
treatment
sentences: Doctors just updated their menopause treatment guidelines.
The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists issued them.
NPR reports it is the first update since 2014.
They cover symptoms like hot flashes, night sweats and insomnia.
Anyone with symptoms should talk with their own doctor.

comments.text: A decade between updates means a lot of new evidence. Good to see it in print.
Guidelines are a starting point. Your own doctor tailors the plan.

comments.who: The one who read the article
comments.text: It covers hot flashes, night sweats and insomnia, the symptoms people often struggle with.
Clinical guidelines get revised as research accumulates. 2014 was a long time ago.
